ios.desc:
The AI calorie tracker you can talk to.

Just tell Gram, our AI nutrition assistant, what you ate — like texting a friend — and instantly get calories, protein, carbs, and fat. No database scrolling. No barcode scanning. No tedious forms.

CHAT-BASED FOOD LOGGING — OUR SIGNATURE

Logging calories should feel like texting a friend, not filling out a form. Type naturally:

• "Scrambled eggs with toast and coffee"
• "Grilled chicken salad for lunch"
• "Slice of pepperoni pizza and a Coke"

Gram instantly calculates calories, protein, carbs, and fats. Food logging has never been this fast. It's the easiest calorie counter you'll ever use.

SNAP A PHOTO WHEN YOU'RE IN A HURRY

Don't feel like typing? Take a photo of your meal and let AI handle the rest. Food photo recognition works with any dish — from home-cooked meals to restaurant food. Perfect for busy mornings or quick meal logging on the go.

MACRO TRACKING MADE SIMPLE

Track your daily nutrition beyond just calories. 0xCal monitors:

• Protein (perfect for fitness goals)
• Carbs (manage your diet with precision)
• Fats (complete nutrition tracking)

See your macro breakdown in beautiful charts. No complicated nutrition tables. Just clean, visual data.

WEIGHT & HEALTH TRACKING

Log your weight and visualize progress over time with elegant graphs. Track your weight loss journey or weight gain goals with Apple Health integration.

INTERMITTENT FASTING, BUILT IN

Pick a fasting plan — 12:12, 14:10, 16:8, or your own — and track your fast in real time. Review your fasting history, and turn on the fasting shield: Screen Time blocks tempting food apps until your fast ends.

WHY 0xCal IS DIFFERENT

Unlike bloated calorie apps that are 200–600MB and packed with features you'll never use, 0xCal is just 25MB. We focus on doing one thing exceptionally well: making calorie counting effortless — by letting you talk to your tracker.

No tedious barcode scanning. No endless meal planning databases. No ads. No clutter.

Built for people who value:
• Clean, minimalist design
• Fast food logging (under 10 seconds per meal)
• AI that actually understands natural language
• Privacy-focused nutrition tracking
• A dark mode that's truly beautiful

BEAUTIFUL DESIGN, DARK MODE INCLUDED

Every calorie tracker app looks the same — cluttered interfaces and overwhelming dashboards. 0xCal is different. We designed an interface you'll actually want to open every day.

Dark mode optimized for OLED. Clean typography. Smooth animations.

quotes.text:
I built a calorie tracker that removes the tedious parts of food logging.

Instead of searching databases, you just describe your meal: "scrambled eggs with toast and coffee" — AI calculates calories, carbs, protein, and fat. You can also snap a photo of food or a nutrition label.

Launched on Product Hunt yesterday and hit #5 with 200 upvotes — the feedback helped shape a lot of my thinking.

The accuracy scales with detail. "Had eggs" gives a ballpark. "2 eggs, 10g butter, 1 slice toast" gets precise. Grams = exact data.

I focused heavily on design — wanted something minimal that feels native to iOS. Most calorie apps look and feel like they haven't been updated since 2015.

Built with SwiftUI, syncs with Apple Health for personalized targets.

Would love feedback from the HN community on the approach. Happy to answer questions about the tech or design decisions.
